svg.title: Adopt the standard in three steps
svg.desc: Pin a released version in docs/registers/subject-vocabulary.json and keep a copy of it, add your own themes and components or replace the core with your own set, and let a suggester propose subjects with reasons. A person accepts them; nothing writes a subject on its own.
